content:
In addition to releasing the first public betas of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple has also released revised versions of these developer betas with new build numbers. Here are the details.

Revised versions released alongside the public betas

Alongside the first public betas, Apple has also released revised versions of developer beta 3 for iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate.

The revised iPadOS 27 developer beta 3 carries build number 24A5380l, while the updated macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 3 carries build number 26A5378n.

It is not immediately clear why Apple has released these revised versions, as no widespread serious issues had been reported with the previous versions. The changes may have been made to address issues discovered before today's public beta rollout, though Apple has not provided any details.

That said, we are looking into these new versions and will report back with anything notable we find.

Have you spotted anything new in the revised versions? Let us know in the comments.
